correctness.rationale: For every nonzero integer linear combination of d consecutive P-values, Vandermonde moment cancellation leaves an irrational nonconstant coefficient, so Weyl gives uniform d-torus distribution. The exact dth finite difference reduces the successor to J=floor(d!alpha-s+weighted independent uniforms); the strictly positive convolution density gives exactly 2^d consecutive correction values, with finite inclusion-exclusion formula. These arguments prove all quantifiers; exact integer checks for d<=5 only corroborate them.

value.rationale: A natural literature-led gap is the first window length at which one-point polynomial-floor modular equidistribution ceases to force a uniform unrestricted symbolic law. The complete universal threshold m<=2^d and positive exact frequencies for every permissible (d+1)-letter pattern quantify a structural boundary across all degrees/moduli and allow application to symbolic dynamics of irrational polynomial sequences. This goes beyond a textbook one-coordinate Weyl corollary or unmotivated numerical slice.
